packageRules.description: One pull request a week for the tools' minor and patch updates
The compile tests need tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/node at the same version, and a new palette needs npm run tokens
CI's Node version and its types move together
The peer ranges are the versions the package is checked with, and changing one is a release (CONTRIBUTING.md, Versioning), so never automatically
KERN updates come from the weekly KERN workflow instead, as an issue with what the new version changes (CONTRIBUTING.md, Updating KERN or Tailwind)
